observations: Blue plastic barrel/drum with a hinged metal clamp-ring lid and two white screw-cap bungs on top.
Three rusty metal hinge/clamp brackets visible holding the lid band in place.
UN-style embossed markings (arrows, '11') on the barrel side, suggesting it was originally an industrial/chemical shipping drum.
Watermark text 'SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on both images - this is the seller's listing watermark, not a product brand.
Surface shows dirt, scuff marks, and faded/worn patches; no visible cracks or holes in the shots given.
Background shows multiple similar drums and jerry cans, indicating a stock/bulk seller.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 appear to be the same drum from nearly identical angles, no interior or base view provided.

identity.kind: used plastic storage drum/barrel (approx. 200L, with clamp-ring lid)

claims.evidence: No photo or detail substantiates 'quality'; it is a generic marketing statement not tied to any visible feature.

risks.risk: Drum may have held hazardous or food-unsafe chemicals previously (UN markings suggest industrial use), affecting resale/use value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any printed labeling, UN code, or manufacturer stamp on the side or base of the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unknown-residue industrial drum, not food-grade

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket condition and whether clamp ring closes tightly (affects usability for liquid storage).
risks.proof: Photo or short video of the lid being opened/closed and the gasket underside.

risks.risk: Possible cracks, dents, or leaks not visible from the two angles shown (both are near-identical top-down views).
risks.proof: Photos of the base, interior, and opposite side of the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified structural integrity, worst case treated as leak risk

risks.risk: Actual capacity unclear (assumed ~200L based on shape, but not confirmed).
risks.proof: Photo of any printed volume marking or a measuring tape against the drum height.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of typical drum capacity for this shape

proof_requests: Clear photo of any printed label, UN code, or volume marking on the drum side or base.
Photo of the drum interior (looking down through the open bung) to check for residue or rust.
Photo/video of the clamp ring and lid being opened to assess gasket and seal condition.
Photo of the drum base and a second side angle to check for dents, cracks, or repairs.
response.reason: This is clearly identifiable by type as a used plastic industrial drum with a clamp lid, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown prior contents, unverified seal, no leak proof) even though no model or brand is readable.
